faq.q: Do all Surrey "mobile homes" sit on rented pads?
faq.a: No. The Surrey feed holds both tenures: park homes where the buyer owns the home and rents the site under a Manufactured Home Site Tenancy Agreement governed by the Manufactured Home Park Tenancy Act, and South Surrey strata communities where the buyer owns the land and pays a strata or community fee instead of pad rent.

faq.q: Do I own the land under a mobile home in Surrey?
faq.a: Usually not. In most parks you own the home and pay monthly pad rent to the park owner, and the tenancy falls under BC's Manufactured Home Park Tenancy Act. Ask for the tenancy agreement, the current pad rent and the park rules before you make an offer.

faq.q: Can I get a mortgage on a mobile home in Surrey?
faq.a: Lenders look at the age of the home, whether it carries a CSA certification label and the terms of the pad tenancy, and some will not finance older homes. Speak to a mortgage broker before you write an offer, not after.

faq.q: How do I find out which school serves an address in Surrey?
faq.a: School catchments are set by address, so use the school district's catchment locator with the exact address. Catchment lines change, so check before you write an offer.
